title: both / either / neither · 高频真题(第4轮)
summary: both/either/neither express the quantity relationships of two objects; mind singular and plural agreement.本课为高频真题练习,核心:both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。
points: both...and... connects two parallel parts
neither...nor... neither...nor...
either...or... either...or...
both of them are / neither of them is
the subject connected by either...or agrees with the nearer one (proximity principle)

examples.en: Both of my parents like traveling.
examples.zh: 我的父母都喜欢旅行。

examples.en: Neither of the answers is right.
examples.zh: 两个答案都不对。

examples.en: You can take either of the two books.
examples.zh: 这两本书你可以拿任意一本。

examples.en: Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.
examples.zh: 汤姆和他妹妹都不在家。

examples.en: Both Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
examples.zh: 莉莉和汤姆都在二班。

examples.en: Either you or he has to clean the classroom.
examples.zh: 要么你要么他得打扫教室。

questions.prompt: 「我的父母都喜欢旅行。」的正确英文是?
options: Neither of my parents like traveling.
All of my parents like traveling.
Either of my parents like traveling.
Both of my parents like traveling.
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Both of my parents like traveling.

questions.prompt: Neither of the answers _____ right.
options: be
is
were
are
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。此处应为 is。句意:两个答案都不对。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: You can take both of the two books.
You can take either of the two books.
You can take all of the two books.
You can take neither of the two books.
questions.explanation: both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:You can take either of the two books.

questions.prompt: 「汤姆和他妹妹都不在家。」的正确英文是?
options: Neither Tom nor his sister were at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister are at home.
Neither Tom nor his sister is being at home.
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Neither Tom nor his sister was at home.

questions.prompt: _____ Lily and Tom are in Class 2.
options: Both
Neither
Either
All
questions.explanation: 考查both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。此处应为 Both。句意:莉莉和汤姆都在二班。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Either you or he having to clean the classroom.
Either you or he has to clean the classroom.
Either you or he are to clean the classroom.
Either you or he have to clean the classroom.
questions.explanation: both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。正确句:Either you or he has to clean the classroom.

title: used to past habits · 高频真题(第4轮)
summary: used to expresses a past habit or state that no longer exists.本课为高频真题练习,核心:used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。
points: used to + base verb
the negative is didn't use to / used not to
the question is Did...use to...?
be used to + V-ing = accustomed to (different meaning)
often contrasted with now

examples.en: He used to play baseball after school.
examples.zh: 他过去放学后常打棒球。

examples.en: There used to be a shop at the corner.
examples.zh: 街角过去有一家商店。

examples.en: She didn't use to like rice.
examples.zh: 她过去不喜欢米饭。

examples.en: I am used to getting up early now.
examples.zh: 我现在习惯早起。

examples.en: Did you use to live in Chengdu?
examples.zh: 你过去住在成都吗?

examples.en: We used to walk to school together.
examples.zh: 我们过去常一起步行上学。

questions.prompt: He _____ baseball after school.
options: used to play
was used to play
used to playing
use to play
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。此处应为 used to play。句意:他过去放学后常打棒球。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: There was used to be a shop at the corner.
There used to be a shop at the corner.
There used to being a shop at the corner.
There use to be a shop at the corner.
questions.explanation: used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:There used to be a shop at the corner.

questions.prompt: 「她过去不喜欢米饭。」的正确英文是?
options: She didn't used to like rice.
She didn't using to like rice.
She didn't use to like rice.
She didn't used like rice.
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:She didn't use to like rice.

questions.prompt: I am used to _____ up early now.
options: get
getting
to get
gets
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。此处应为 getting。句意:我现在习惯早起。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Did you using to live in Chengdu?
Did you use to live in Chengdu?
Did you used to live in Chengdu?
Did you used live in Chengdu?
questions.explanation: used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:Did you use to live in Chengdu?

questions.prompt: 「我们过去常一起步行上学。」的正确英文是?
options: We used to walk to school together.
We were used to walk to school together.
We used to walking to school together.
We use to walk to school together.
questions.explanation: 考查used to + base verb = often did something in the past (not now)。正确句:We used to walk to school together.

title: as...as comparisons · 高频真题(第4轮)
summary: as...as expresses 'as...as'; the negative not as...as means 'not as...as'.本课为高频真题练习,核心:as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。
points: as + adjective base form + as
the negative is not as/so + adjective + as
the same...as = the same as
as...as possible = as...as possible
in the negative, the latter part means a downward comparison

examples.en: Tom is as tall as his brother.
examples.zh: 汤姆和他哥哥一样高。

examples.en: This bag is not as expensive as that one.
examples.zh: 这个包不如那个贵。

examples.en: Please come back as soon as possible.
examples.zh: 请尽快回来。

examples.en: She runs as fast as her sister.
examples.zh: 她跑得和她姐姐一样快。

examples.en: My phone is the same color as yours.
examples.zh: 我的手机和你的颜色一样。

examples.en: Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
examples.zh: 今天不如昨天冷。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: Tom is tall as his brother.
Tom is so tall as his brother.
Tom is as taller as his brother.
Tom is as tall as his brother.
questions.explanation: as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:Tom is as tall as his brother.

questions.prompt: 「这个包不如那个贵。」的正确英文是?
options: This bag is not so expensive than that one.
This bag is not as expensiver as that one.
This bag is not expensive as that one.
This bag is not as expensive as that one.
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:This bag is not as expensive as that one.

questions.prompt: Please come back _____.
options: as sooner as possible
as soon as possible
as soon as can
so soon as possible
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。此处应为 as soon as possible。句意:请尽快回来。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She runs so fast as her sister.
She runs as faster as her sister.
She runs as fast as her sister.
She runs fast as her sister.
questions.explanation: as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:She runs as fast as her sister.

questions.prompt: 「我的手机和你的颜色一样。」的正确英文是?
options: My phone is same like color as yours.
My phone is the same color as yours.
My phone is as same color as yours.
My phone is such same color as yours.
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。正确句:My phone is the same color as yours.

questions.prompt: Today isn't _____ yesterday.
options: cold as
as colder as
so cold than
as cold as
questions.explanation: 考查as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。此处应为 as cold as。句意:今天不如昨天冷。

title: Present perfect have/has + past participle · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: have/has + past participle expresses an action that happened in the past and its impact on the present.本课为混合演练练习,核心:Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。
points: have/has + past participle
often with already, yet, just, ever, never
the negative is haven't/hasn't + past participle
Have you ever...? asks about experience
distinguish from the past simple: no specific past time is given

examples.en: I have finished my homework already.
examples.zh: 我已经完成了作业。

examples.en: She has lived here for ten years.
examples.zh: 她在这里住了十年了。

examples.en: The visitors have arrived at the park.
examples.zh: 访客已经到达公园。

examples.en: Have you ever been to London?
examples.zh: 你去过伦敦吗?

examples.en: He hasn't seen this movie yet.
examples.zh: 他还没看过这部电影。

examples.en: We have known each other since 2018.
examples.zh: 我们从2018年起就认识。

questions.prompt: 「我已经完成了作业。」的正确英文是?
options: I have finished my homework already.
I has finished my homework already.
I finished have my homework already.
I have finish my homework already.
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。正确句:I have finished my homework already.

questions.prompt: She _____ here for ten years.
options: have lived
lived has
has live
has lived
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。此处应为 has lived。句意:她在这里住了十年了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: The visitors have arrive at the park.
The visitors has arrived at the park.
The visitors arrived have at the park.
The visitors have arrived at the park.
questions.explanation: Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。正确句:The visitors have arrived at the park.

questions.prompt: 「你去过伦敦吗?」的正确英文是?
options: Have you ever gone to London?
Have you ever been to London?
Have you ever went to London?
Have you ever being to London?
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。正确句:Have you ever been to London?

questions.prompt: He hasn't _____ this movie yet.
options: see
seen
saw
seeing
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。此处应为 seen。句意:他还没看过这部电影。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We have known each other since 2018.
We has known each other since 2018.
We know have each other since 2018.
We have knew each other since 2018.
questions.explanation: Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。正确句:We have known each other since 2018.

title: Present perfect vs past simple · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: Determine the tense by whether there is a past time adverbial and whether the present result matters.本课为混合演练练习,核心:Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。
points: with yesterday, last year, in 2010 use the past simple
with already, yet, so far use the present perfect
just now = just a moment ago, use the past simple; just = just now, use the present perfect
have been to = went and came back; have gone to = went and hasn't returned
when asking about experience use Have you ever...

examples.en: I saw this movie last week.
examples.zh: 我上周看了这部电影。

examples.en: She has lost her keys and can't open the door.
examples.zh: 她丢了钥匙,打不开门。

examples.en: Tom went to Chengdu in 2019.
examples.zh: 汤姆2019年去了成都。

examples.en: He has worked here since last year.
examples.zh: 他从去年起一直在这里工作。

examples.en: They came back just now.
examples.zh: 他们刚回来。

examples.en: So far we have learned five units.
examples.zh: 到目前为止我们学了五个单元。

questions.prompt: I _____ this movie last week.
options: have seen
see
has seen
saw
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。此处应为 saw。句意:我上周看了这部电影。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She lost her keys and can't open the door.
She loses her keys and can't open the door.
She has lost her keys and can't open the door.
She have lost her keys and can't open the door.
questions.explanation: Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。正确句:She has lost her keys and can't open the door.

questions.prompt: 「汤姆2019年去了成都。」的正确英文是?
options: Tom has been to Chengdu in 2019.
Tom has gone to Chengdu in 2019.
Tom goes to Chengdu in 2019.
Tom went to Chengdu in 2019.
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。正确句:Tom went to Chengdu in 2019.

questions.prompt: He _____ here since last year.
options: is working
has worked
have worked
worked
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。此处应为 has worked。句意:他从去年起一直在这里工作。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: They came back just now.
They have come back just now.
They has come back just now.
They come back just now.
questions.explanation: Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。正确句:They came back just now.

questions.prompt: 「到目前为止我们学了五个单元。」的正确英文是?
options: So far we learned five units.
So far we have learned five units.
So far we learn five units.
So far we has learned five units.
questions.explanation: 考查Present perfect emphasizes impact on the present; past simple states a past event with an explicit past time。正确句:So far we have learned five units.

title: for / since time phrases · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: The time adverbials of the present perfect: for takes a duration, since takes a starting point.本课为混合演练练习,核心:for + length of time; since + point in time。
points: for + a period: for two years
since + a point in time: since 2020
since + clause: since he left
How long...? asks about duration
The main clause of for/since phrases often uses the perfect tense

examples.en: We have studied English for six years.
examples.zh: 我们学英语六年了。

examples.en: She has been in this school since 2021.
examples.zh: 她从2021年起就在这所学校。

examples.en: I haven't seen him since last August.
examples.zh: 自上八月以来我一直没见过他。

examples.en: They have lived here for a long time.
examples.zh: 他们在这里住了很久了。

examples.en: How long have you kept this hobby?
examples.zh: 这个爱好你保持多久了?

examples.en: Much has changed since we met.
examples.zh: 自从我们认识后,变化很大。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: We have studied English for six years.
We have studied English since six years.
We have studied English at six years.
We have studied English in six years.
questions.explanation: for + length of time; since + point in time。正确句:We have studied English for six years.

questions.prompt: 「她从2021年起就在这所学校。」的正确英文是?
options: She has been in this school since 2021.
She has been in this school at 2021.
She has been in this school from 2021.
She has been in this school for 2021.
questions.explanation: 考查for + length of time; since + point in time。正确句:She has been in this school since 2021.

questions.prompt: I haven't seen him _____ last August.
options: in
since
for
during
questions.explanation: 考查for + length of time; since + point in time。此处应为 since。句意:自上八月以来我一直没见过他。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: They have lived here for a long time.
They have lived here since a long time.
They have lived here during a long time.
They have lived here before a long time.
questions.explanation: for + length of time; since + point in time。正确句:They have lived here for a long time.

questions.prompt: 「这个爱好你保持多久了?」的正确英文是?
options: How long have you kept this hobby?
How long have you keeping this hobby?
How long have you keep this hobby?
How long have you keeped this hobby?
questions.explanation: 考查for + length of time; since + point in time。正确句:How long have you kept this hobby?

questions.prompt: Much has changed _____ we met.
options: for
from
by
since
questions.explanation: 考查for + length of time; since + point in time。此处应为 since。句意:自从我们认识后,变化很大。

title: Past continuous · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: The past continuous depicts what was happening at a certain past time.本课为混合演练练习,核心:was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。
points: was + V-ing (I/he/she/it)
were + V-ing (you/we/they)
often with at that time, at eight last night
the negative is was/were not + V-ing
the question moves was/were before the subject

examples.en: I was reading at nine last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚九点我正在读书。

examples.en: They were playing basketball at that time.
examples.zh: 那时他们正在打篮球。

examples.en: She was cooking noodles when I called.
examples.zh: 我打电话时她正在做面条。

examples.en: We were walking to the gym in the rain.
examples.zh: 我们那时正冒雨走向健身房。

examples.en: He wasn't watching TV at eight last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚八点他没在看电视。

examples.en: What were you doing at noon yesterday?
examples.zh: 昨天中午你在做什么?

questions.prompt: 「昨晚九点我正在读书。」的正确英文是?
options: I read at nine last night.
I was read at nine last night.
I were reading at nine last night.
I was reading at nine last night.
questions.explanation: 考查was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。正确句:I was reading at nine last night.

questions.prompt: They _____ basketball at that time.
options: were playing
played
were play
was playing
questions.explanation: 考查was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。此处应为 were playing。句意:那时他们正在打篮球。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: She cooked noodles when I called.
She were cooking noodles when I called.
She was cooking noodles when I called.
She was cook noodles when I called.
questions.explanation: was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。正确句:She was cooking noodles when I called.

questions.prompt: 「我们那时正冒雨走向健身房。」的正确英文是?
options: We were walk to the gym in the rain.
We walked to the gym in the rain.
We was walking to the gym in the rain.
We were walking to the gym in the rain.
questions.explanation: 考查was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。正确句:We were walking to the gym in the rain.

questions.prompt: He _____ TV at eight last night.
options: weren't watching
wasn't watching
not watched
wasn't watch
questions.explanation: 考查was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。此处应为 wasn't watching。句意:昨晚八点他没在看电视。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: What was you doing at noon yesterday?
What were you doing at noon yesterday?
What did you doing at noon yesterday?
What are you doing at noon yesterday?
questions.explanation: was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。正确句:What were you doing at noon yesterday?

title: when / while and the past continuous · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: was/were doing + when + past simple: the continuous is the background, the past simple is the interrupting event.本课为混合演练练习,核心:The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。
points: when + past simple: sudden short action
while + past continuous: ongoing background
was doing when did = was in the middle of doing something when something happened
while can join two parallel continuous actions
when can replace while + state, but not vice versa

examples.en: I was doing my homework when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我正在做作业,这时电话响了。

examples.en: While she was shopping, she met her old friend.
examples.zh: 她购物时遇到了老朋友。

examples.en: We were having dinner when the lights went out.
examples.zh: 我们正吃着晚饭,突然停电了。

examples.en: While they were playing chess, it began to rain.
examples.zh: 他们打国际象棋时下起了雨。

examples.en: He fell asleep while he was reading.
examples.zh: 他读书时睡着了。

examples.en: When I came in, they were talking about English.
examples.zh: 我进来时他们正在谈论英语。

questions.prompt: I _____ my homework when the phone rang.
options: did
was do
was doing
were doing
questions.explanation: 考查The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。此处应为 was doing。句意:我正在做作业,这时电话响了。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: While she shopped, she met her old friend.
While she is shopping, she met her old friend.
While she was shopping, she met her old friend.
While she were shopping, she met her old friend.
questions.explanation: The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。正确句:While she was shopping, she met her old friend.

questions.prompt: 「我们正吃着晚饭,突然停电了。」的正确英文是?
options: We were having dinner when the lights was going out.
We were having dinner when the lights went out.
We were having dinner when the lights go out.
We were having dinner when the lights were going out.
questions.explanation: 考查The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。正确句:We were having dinner when the lights went out.

questions.prompt: While they were playing chess, it _____ to rain.
options: begins
were beginning
began
was beginning
questions.explanation: 考查The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。此处应为 began。句意:他们打国际象棋时下起了雨。

questions.prompt: 下面哪一句是正确的?
options: He fell asleep while he was reading.
He fell asleep while he reads.
He fell asleep while he read.
He fell asleep while he were reading.
questions.explanation: The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。正确句:He fell asleep while he was reading.

questions.prompt: 「我进来时他们正在谈论英语。」的正确英文是?
options: When I came in, they are talking about English.
When I came in, they talked about English.
When I came in, they were talking about English.
When I came in, they was talking about English.
questions.explanation: 考查The longer action in the past continuous is the background; the shorter action in the past simple interrupts it。正确句:When I came in, they were talking about English.

title: Past perfect · 混合演练(第4轮)
summary: The past perfect expresses an action completed before a past reference point: by the time / before / after.本课为混合演练练习,核心:had + past participle indicates 'past of the past'。
points: had + past participle
often with by the time, before, after, when
emphasizes the sequence of two past actions
the negative is had not (hadn't) + past participle
in reported speech, the past simple moves to the past perfect

examples.en: When I got to the station, the train had left.
examples.zh: 我到车站时火车已经开走了。

examples.en: She had finished the report before the meeting.
examples.zh: 会前她已经完成了报告。

examples.en: By the time we arrived, they had gone home.
examples.zh: 我们到时他们已经回家了。

examples.en: I realized I had forgotten my wallet.
examples.zh: 我意识到我忘带钱包了。

examples.en: He told me he had seen the film twice.
examples.zh: 他告诉我这部电影他看过两遍了。

title: Object clauses with that · 阶段复盘(第4轮)

the object clause must use statement word order: I think that he is right

the tense follows the main clause

title: Object clauses with if / whether and question words · 阶段复盘(第4轮)
summary: if/whether and special question words introduce object clauses; the key exam point is word order.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:Object clauses with question words still use statement word order。

title: Adverbial clauses of time with when / before / after · 阶段复盘(第4轮)

as soon as = as soon as

summary: A verb after a preposition takes the gerund: at/in/on/of/for/about + V-ing.本课为阶段复盘练习,核心:Prepositions are followed by V-ing: be good at doing, be interested in doing。
